UN Chief Calls for Security Council Reform in Final Address

UN Secretary-General António Guterres, in his final address to the UN General Assembly, called for reforms to the Security Council. He stated that the council must reflect the current reality of the world and that superpowers alone cannot solve global problems. Guterres noted that humanity faces an unprecedented convergence of threats, while mechanisms for collective action are under strain, with world fault lines described as having turned from cracks into canyons.
